name: rowboat-monorepo-tooling
description: Root tooling package: pins the repo-wide quality-gate toolchain (lefthook git hooks, Prettier formatting, commit-message linting). Application code lives under apps/* and packages/*. This package is intentionally minimal and is NOT a pnpm workspace root — install it with `pnpm install --ignore-workspace` (or `npm install`) to set up git hooks. NOTE: deliberately no `packageManager` field — it would conflict with `pnpm/action-setup`'s `version:` input in CI (ERR_PNPM_BAD_PM_VERSION).
